name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 107/2
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: and foods associated with an increased risk of cancer
part_context: Highlights the fact that proportionate and evidence-based fiscal and price-based measures play a role in health protection; encourages the Member States, in line with national competences, to use these instruments as part of a comprehensive cancer prevention strategy; suggests that Member States assess the potential of using revenue from taxation and duties on tobacco products and foods associated with an increased risk of cancer as a way to finance national cancer plans and ensure their long-term sustainability;
